process_summary: Operator places component on fixture tray. Operator presses dual two-hand cycle-start buttons. Front automatic door closes (slides from top per intake). Fisnar robot applies sealant path for selected model/program. Cycle completes; door opens; operator unloads part. On idle, parking and purging sequence moves tip to parking/purging cups to prevent tip dry-out (HMI Idle Time To Go Parking = 3.0 min as photographed).

hazards_narrative_topics: Robot / axis motion — impact, shear, entanglement at dispenser tip and moving head
Front automatic door motion — crush/impact during close
Side door access during motion if interlock defeated
Pneumatic energy — unexpected actuator/door motion; residual pressure
Electrical energy — control panel shock risk during troubleshooting
Sealant chemical exposure — skin/eye/respiratory (product SDS missing)
Tip dry-out / process quality if parking-purge not used
Two-hand or interlock bypass — elevated injury risk
ppe: Eye protection when handling sealant or purging
Chemical-resistant gloves suitable for sealant product (per SDS when available)
standards_in_use: ISO 13849-1 (principles — no PLr claims without assessment)

open_actions.description: Commission a formal Machine Safety Assessment by an Independent Safety Consultant. No RA report exists; residual risk and PLr claims cannot be finalised from photos alone.
Confirm electrical supply data: voltage, phases, frequency, full-load current / kW, machine serial number, year of manufacture. Photograph complete nameplate if present.
Provide electrical schematic drawings for Section 9 insert (customer may paste drawings). Include panel layout and main isolator circuit.
Provide pneumatic schematic drawings for Section 9 insert (door cylinders, FRL, dispenser air path, isolation valves).
Validate front automatic safety door: closing force/edge protection, interlock behaviour, and residual risk of no light curtain at operator load face. Document required administrative controls.
Document sealant product identity, SDS, dispenser capacity, pot life / tip dry-out limit, and confirm idle parking time policy (HMI shows 3.0 min).
Confirm pneumatic isolation device is lockable (ball valve/hasp) and isolator lockout hardware (hasp/padlock) is available for LP-01/LP-02.
Export full HMI/PLC alarm list and I/O map from project file (only partial live alarms captured in photos).
Confirm exact Mitsubishi PLC and HMI model numbers, software version, and network addresses for maintenance records.
Fill end-user facility name, site address, PPE matrix, training matrix, and authorised persons list.
Confirm robot axis speed limits, program ownership (who may teach), and whether teach mode is locked for production operators.
Map tower-light colour meanings (red/amber/green) to machine states for operator training.
